info.name: Flipdish API - Apps Accounts API
info.description:
Flipdish Open API v1.0 — Apps operations. Flipdish is an online ordering and branded-app platform for restaurants and takeaways. This specification was derived from the official Flipdish Swagger document and grouped by resource domain.

Contact Support:
 Name: Flipdish Support
 Email: help@flipdish.com
